chapters.label: Moscow, live
chapters.text: Moscow, 2008, the Champions League final. Rio Ferdinand has a sore leg. But when Frank Lampard threads a pass into the box, Rio reads it, steps across, and cuts it out!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. As Lampard passes, Rio takes one smooth step into its path, and his boot gets there first.

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: That's Rio's signature: the smooth interception. Read the pass and step in first. After you win the ball, stay calm, lift your head, and make a simple pass.
